fusions.name: Trotline
fusions.desc: Strings a 5-tile line of baited barbs ahead of you for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 11 damage to each one it catches, stuns it for 1 second and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Landing Gaff
fusions.desc: A long gaff stroke on a target up to 5 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Baited Barb
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a baited barb at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 30 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles sets it off: it deals 22 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Snagged in Passing
fusions.desc: Each time you strike with your weapon, a barbed line snags the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, deals 5 damage and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
